Subtract 10 months from 1880-03-15 → 1880 - 0 years, so 10 months back from March is May of previous year: 1880-03 → 1880-02 → 1880-01 → 1879-12 → 1879-11 → 1879-10 → 1879-09 → 1879-08 → 1879-07 → 1879-06 → 1879-05.  
Now subtract 22 days from 1879-05-15: May has 31 days, so 15 - 22 = -7 days → go back into April: April has 30 days, so April 30 is -1 day from May 1, April 23 is -8 days from May 1, so April 23 is 8 days before May 1. Need 7 days before May 1 → April 24.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1879-04-24
